text: 【音乐】Are you ready?Let's start.Listen, a food train is coming.Apple pie, banana pie, we can buy them in a food shop.Shop.Look, a girl is at the shop.She is Bonnie.Bonnie.She is running after a dog.How is the dog?Yes, it's hot.In these words, 哦 is pronounced as 哦.Let's read the words together.哦 or Bonnie.Ready?哦 or dog.哦 or hot.哦 or shop.In this unit, we are going to talk about shopping.Kitty wants to go shopping for a picnic.She needs some fruit.What does she want?Apple, peach, maybe.Look, these are the top 6 at the fruit shop.Please look at the shadows.Let's guess and say.It's round.What is it?Good, orange.Read out to me.哦 or orange.Number 5.Yes, pear.Pear.Apple.No, it's small.It's purple.Look, plum.You are plum.Yes, banana.Banana.Good, peach.Peach.Top one is the apple.Together, apple.Then, what does Kitty want?Please listen and take.I want an orange.It's for Danny.I want 6 apples.Apples are good.I want 5 bananas.We all like bananas.I want 2 peaches.One for Peter and one for me.Look, this is my shopping list.What's your answer?Apple, peach, banana.The last one.Look, Kitty is making the shopping list.Without me, shopping list.She can write what she wants and how many she wants on the shopping list.Now we know what she wants.Let's read and spell.Orange, orange.O-R-A-N-G-E, orange.Then, how many oranges, apples, bananas and peaches does Kitty want?Please listen and complete.First, how many oranges?Yes, one orange.We can also say an orange.Read after me.An orange.Yes, an orange is for Danny.He likes oranges.Listen.I like oranges.They are orange.They are juicy.Let's read together.So, Kitty wants an orange for Danny.Please listen and follow.Next, how many apples?An apple?No, 6 apples.Apples are good for our health.Do you like apples?Let's sing.Apple orange, apple red, apple juicy, apple sweet.Apple, apple, I love you.Apple sweet, I love to eat.Nice.Please read after Kitty.Then, how many bananas?Yes, 5 bananas.All of Kitty and her friends like bananas.Bananas, bananas, soft and nice.Bananas, bananas, we like bananas.Let's try together.Good job.The last one, how many peaches?Yes, 2 peaches.1 peach, 2 peaches.Pay attention, we should add es.Read again.Peaches.Both Kitty and Peter like peaches.Can you read?Have a try.1 peach, 2 peaches, sweet, sweet, sweet.1 peach, 2 peaches for you and me.Good.So Kitty says.Great.We finished the shopping list.So tell me, Kitty, what do you want?Yes, I want an orange.What do you want?Then boys, can you ask?Let's say together.The last one, girls, ask please.Together.Let's read.Why does Kitty want this fruit?Please listen again.Then please read after Kitty.Now you will be Kitty.Please look and say.And how about Kitty's friend?What do they want?Let's enjoy a song.I want an apple.Peaches, apples and plums.Look at Tom's shopping list.Let's try to read like this.One apple.We can also say an apple.The last one, 2 plums.Yes, I want 4 peaches.I want 2 plums.What do you want Tom?Let's sing the song together.Nice song.Then you will be Tom.Let's talk about the shopping list.If you can say like this, one star for you.If you can add more reasons, two stars for you.Start.Who can try?They are for Kitty and Peter.It's good.They are sweet.Well done.Children, what fruit do you want?Let's make a shopping list.Please open your books and turn to page 31.Let's think and write.Let's have a look.Can you talk about your shopping list?We like peaches.They are for my grandfather and grandmother.You can finish it after class.And also, please listen and read page 30 and page 33 of your student book.Look and learn.Listen and enjoy.Learn the sound.Finish the exercise on page 45 of your workbook.Part A.Listen and circle.Read the passage about
